name: Cheyenne Frontier Days local story reel
brief:

Topic: Cheyenne Frontier Days. The only facts you may use: it was first held in Cheyenne in 1897, and it is nicknamed the "Daddy of 'em All". Source: https://www.cfdrodeo.com. Do not claim it happens every year (it was cancelled in 2020) or add any other dates, numbers or claims.
Style: bold-news. Voice: the stock presenter voice. Length: about 20 seconds.
Leo fact-checks claims and may ask for the city or ask you to confirm its script; those steps can be skipped when the first message already answers them. Before rendering it shows a "Needs your approval" card with Approve (this spends money): approve when the plan on that card matches this scenario. Once the video is ready it shows a card with Complete Task.
